Diagnostics
Product categories
Which depth of the Fishbowl Product Tree Sales by Category and the Product Category filter group by. At level 2, Bike Parts > Accessories > Sub Accessories reports under Bike Parts > Accessories; a branch shallower than the chosen level reports at its own deepest level.
Maintenance
Clears your personal settings and returns to the published default.

📖 Instructions

Layout
  • Click the padlock to unlock editing — drag a widget by its header, resize from any edge
  • Add Widget opens the picker; Save Layout stores your personal arrangement
  • KPI badges in the header: drag to reorder, hover for ✕, + to add more
Filters & data
  • The filter strip applies to every widget — date range plus customer group, category, salesperson and margin tier
  • Click a Top Customers bar or an order number to drill into the underlying orders
  • Categories show their full Product Tree path — set the roll-up depth in Settings ▸ Product categories ▸ Category level; admins publish it as the org default with Publish
  • Admins (Fishbowl Admin access) can Publish the current layout/filters as the org-wide default and lock user editing

Add Widget

Select a report type. Tiles can be resized and rearranged after adding.

Click a column to sort · click an order row to expand its line items · click an order # to open it in Fishbowl
